Enter uv, a blazing-fast Python package manager + environment manager. Think of uv as the next-gen replacement for pip/venv/poetry. It makes project setup faster, cleaner, and way more consistent. And yes, you can use it seamlessly with Jupyter Notebooks. Here’s how to set it up 👇 We’ll register a new Jupyter kernel that uses a uv-managed environment.
